title: NoMobSpawn
description: A lightweight mod to block specific mob spawns
body:
**NoMobSpawn is a lightweight Fabric mod that allows you to completely block specific mobs from spawning in your world.** ## Client-compatible **Only for `singleplayer/local` worlds!**
- **Singleplayer & LAN:** Install the mod into your client's mods folder, and it will work perfectly in your worlds. - **Joining other servers:** If you connect to third-party servers, the mod will harmlessly sit in the background. It will not cause crashes and will not prevent you from joining any servers. ## For which server types The mod is **Server-Side**. This means it is compatible with all types of Fabric-based servers: - Local hosts - Public and Private Servers - **Key Advantage:** Players joining your server DO NOT need to install this mod. It functions entirely on the server side. ## Config location Settings are saved per-world at: `.../[world_folder]/nomobspawn/nomobspawn.json` ## Core Mod Commands > ⚠️ **Note:** By default, all commands from this list are available only to players with permission level 3 (Admin) and higher. **There are 5 permission levels in total (0-4).** [`Configurable parameter`] - `/nomobspawn [mob_ID]` - adds a mob to the blacklist - `/nomobspawn remove [mob_ID]` - removes a mob from the blacklist - `/nomobspawn list` - displays the list of blocked mobs - `/nomobspawn list clear` - completely clears the blacklist of blocked mobs - `/nomobspawn all` - adds all mobs to the blacklist - `/nomobspawn all clear` - disables the global spawn block for all mobs - `/nomobspawn mob remove` - purges all blacklisted mobs from the world ## Permission Setup Commands > ⚠️ **Note:** All commands from this list are available only to players with permission level 4 (Owner). - `/nms perm get` - displays the current permission level - `/nms perm set <0-4>` - sets the required permission level for the core mod commands ## Notes By default, a local world also acts as a server. This means you have the maximum permission level and can use all commands.
When playing on a multiplayer server, you must have the required permission level to use commands. Please consult the server owner for details.
This mod works with most modded mobs. If a specific mob does not appear in the command suggestion list, you can still type its ID manually. ## GitHub **If you have any questions or suggestions, please visit the project's GitHub.**
